exercises.deleteExerciseConfirm: Delete this exercise and all its history?

cycle.calc1rmHint: Don't know your 1RM? Estimate it from a recent set.
cycle.closeCycleConfirm: Close this cycle? It will move to history.
cycle.cycleEndNear: You're close to the end of the cycle! Once you hit ~15 reps, close it and start a new one with more weight.

projection.title: Projection
projection.notEnoughData: Log at least 2 sessions to see the projection

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Save all your progress (exercises, cycles, sessions and settings) to a file. No account needed: use it to move to another device or to recover if something breaks.

exportDone.shared: Backup created: {{summary}}. Save it somewhere you can get it back.

settings.lastBackupNever: You haven't made a backup yet.
settings.importMergeHint: Adds what's missing and keeps the most recent version of each record.
settings.importReplaceHint: Leaves this device with only what's in the file.
settings.importConfirmMerge: Merge the backup from {{date}} ({{summary}}) into this device's data.
settings.importConfirmReplace: Replace ALL data on this device with the backup from {{date}} ({{summary}}). This can't be undone.
settings.importDone: Imported: {{summary}}. If you have an account, it will upload on the next sync.

backupError.invalidJson: The file is damaged or isn't valid JSON.
backupError.notABackup: That file isn't a Project Explosive backup.
backupError.unsupportedVersion: This backup was made with a newer version of the app. Update it and try again.
backupError.emptyBackup: This backup contains no training data.
backupError.generic: Couldn't complete the operation. Please try again.

settings.aboutBilbo: The Bilbo method: one explosive set starting at 50% of your 1RM, adding weight every session until you reach ~15 reps.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Sign in to keep your progress in the cloud and train from your phone or your computer.
account.confirmEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open it and sign in again.
account.fullSyncHint: Compares everything against the cloud again. Only use it if something looks off.
account.offlineHint: Changes are saved on this device and upload on their own once you are back online.
account.notConfigured: Sync is not enabled in this build of the app.
account.notConfiguredHint: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in your .env file (see SYNC.md).
account.otherAccountWarning: Signing in with a different account replaces the data stored on this device with that account's data.
account.networkError: No connection to the server. Your changes are still saved on this device.
account.signOutPending: Didn't sign out: {{count}} changes are still waiting to upload. Reconnect and try again so you don't lose them.
account.signOutHint: Anything pending is uploaded first, then this device is wiped. Your data stays in the cloud and comes back when you sign in.

welcome.title: Save your progress
welcome.body: Sign in to back up your workouts to the cloud and see them on all your devices, or keep using the app on this device only.
welcome.hint: You can change this any time in Settings.
